title: Jesus's return in the first photograph of the Shroud

tellings.quote: It was 1898 when the first photograph was taken of the shroud. That was the moment he returned and we saw him on the shroud.

plain: An author named Whitley Strieber says that in 1898, when the first photograph was taken of the Shroud of Turin, a cloth kept in Italy that some believe shows the image of Jesus, that moment was Jesus's return. In his view, people saw him again in that photograph, an idea he connects to a book titled Jesus: A New Vision. If true, it would recast the second coming as something that already happened through a camera.
